steps.description:
Click here to download the template 

Project Report Deck

You can change the design theme

Slide 2: Change your name on the cover page

Slide 3: Change to your project titles

Slide 4-5: Do not need to change

Slide 6-9: Refer to the example and replace with your own project contents

Slide 10-13: Add in your own project contents

To screenshot your code or flowchart,
- for windows user, press "win + shift + s" and click-drag to select region to capture
- for mac user, press "command + shift + 4" and click-drag to select region to capture
- then go to PowerPoint and paste (ctrl-v for windows / command-v for mac)

Submit to "instructor@thelab.sg" when done either via attaching it in email or via google drive link
